Celestial Frontier

The universe is older than any chart and wider than any reckoning — and yet it can be known. You begin where every explorer begins: one small world, a borrowed ship, and a whole sky that has never learned your name.

The Prime Codex is the master survey — the nine elemental forces from which all creation is wrought, each ruled by a titan that embodies it. Fell a titan and you master its element. Master all nine, and you have mastered the forces of the universe itself — and the Celestial Frontier, the truth beyond the charted sky, opens only to a master.

You cannot finish the infinite. You can master it.

First, what shall the stars call you?

✦ The Prime Codex
Master the nine. The Prime Codex is the master survey of the elemental forces that compose the universe — each ruled by a titan that embodies it. Fell a titan and its element is yours to command; the basics wait near home, Void and Prism far past the Deep Field. Master all nine, and the Celestial Frontier — the truth beyond the charted sky — opens to you.

The Celestial Frontier
The Prime Codex is complete. You have mastered all nine elements, and with them the forces of the universe itself. The Celestial Frontier opens — and asks what kind of Pathfinder you are. Your choice becomes your legacy; the galaxy stays open, endless, yours to know.
